run1_params_note: the value-sweep template (c1_template, few_shot, c1_a), the 200 addition problems (c2_template, c2_seed, c2_operand_range, c2_problems, c2_max_new_tokens, c2_batch) and the C3 doc (c3_text_cell, c3_text_file, c3_doc, c3_L, c3_skip, c3_shuffle_seed, c3_top_fraction) are READ from this file by path at run time, never retyped; the problems are generated by run 1's own c2_problems()
model_note: the SAME checkpoint as run 1 (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct HF weights, cell osc03_hf_dir) for comparability with run 1, not the base model; fp32 CPU, raw completion (no chat template). Neurons = mlp.down_proj input act_fn(gate_proj(x)) * up_proj(x), flat id = layer * 4864 + index, read at the last prompt token via run 1's Neurons hooks
detrend: per neuron, remove the least-squares fit c0 + c1*a over a = 0..99 (projection onto span{1, a}) BEFORE the rfft; a residual with sum of squares <= detrend_tol * the neuron's centred sum of squares (exact ramps, constants, dead neurons) is set to 0, so its peakiness is 0. Peakiness and dominant bin k = run 1's peakiness() on the residual; period = 100 / k
null_def: detrended label-shuffled null: permute the raw activations along a (20 perms, seed 0), THEN detrend against the a-slot index and take peakiness; pooled 20 x 116736 values, 99.9th pct
twin_def: random-init twin: from_config after torch.manual_seed(0) (as run 1), same prompts, SEPARATE process (--twin) before the main run; null 2 = max detrended peakiness over all 116736 twin neurons
d1_set: neurons whose detrended peakiness > null q999 AND > twin detrended max (both strict)
families_note: membership rule fixed here BEFORE any D2 number exists: a family = the D1-set neurons whose dominant DETRENDED rfft bin k is in the listed bins (k=50 -> period 2; k=20 -> period 5, k=10 -> period 10). Every member is ablated (no top-k).
random_def: layer-matched, size-matched: for seed s, rng = numpy default_rng(s); for each layer in ascending order draw (without replacement) exactly the family's count in that layer from that layer's 4864 neurons EXCLUDING the family's own members
mean_def: mean-ablation (SCORED): replace each ablated neuron's down_proj input with its mean over the 100 value prompts (run 1's c1_template, a = 0..99, real model, last token '+'), at every token position; zero-ablation (input * 0) reported, unscored
score_def: teacher forcing: ids = tokens(prompt) + tokens(str(a+b)) (asserted equal to tokens(prompt + str(a+b))), right-padded within a batch; per problem logp = SUM over the sum's 2-3 digit tokens of log softmax(logits at the preceding position)[gold token] = log P(full correct sum | prompt); metric = mean over the 200 problems; drop = baseline metric - arm metric. Exact match = run 1's addition_acc (greedy argmax, 4 new tokens, leading digit run == str(a+b)), reported
verdict_rule: D1 pass = fraction of all 116736 neurons in the D1 set >= 0.005. D2 pass = for at least one family in {T2, T5_10}, its mean-ablation drop > the mean-ablation drop of EVERY one of its 5 layer-matched random sets (strict). An empty family cannot pass. D1 and D2 -> proved; either fails -> disproved. VOID if: the neuron grid is not 24 x 4864, the twin or the null is missing / wrong shape, any random set's per-layer counts differ from its family's or it intersects the family, or the activations npz files were not written. A family with < 10 members is scored but flagged.
c3_def: reported, unscored: run 1's C3 doc (article 13, first 2048 tokens, positions 0-3 dropped); per neuron the 2044-long position series with NUMBER TOKENS MASKED (positions whose token text contains a digit are set to the neuron's mean over the unmasked positions of that series) is detrended (same rule) and its peakiness taken; score = doc peakiness - peakiness of the same tokens in run 1's shuffled order (mask follows the tokens); top floor(0.01 * 116736) = 1167 by score; overlap with the D1 set vs the LAYER-STRATIFIED expectation sum_l n3_l * K_l / 4864, p = P(X >= overlap) under the sum of independent per-layer hypergeometrics (exact convolution); the unstratified run-1 expectation reported beside it
saved: value_acts.npz (real) and value_acts_twin.npz (twin): acts (100, 116736) FLOAT16 (the analysis ran on the float32 array in memory; float16 is storage only), plus float32 per-neuron raw peakiness, detrended peakiness and int16 dominant detrended bin k for ALL 116736 neurons
